name: @repo/time-agent
description: Desktop agent that reads ActivityWatch (and macOS call history) and sends time blocks to Plan

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile dist/plan-time.mjs --banner '/* eslint-disable */' && cp dist/plan-time.mjs ../../apps/web/public/plan-time.mjs && prettier --write ../../apps/web/public/plan-time.mjs
